profile.description: Current 2026 review is not a strong Adventure Zone prospect. Casper Oktoberfest is historically a one-afternoon downtown charity beer crawl benefiting Make-A-Wish Wyoming, and no official 2026 edition was verified.

notes.subject: 2026 review — unconfirmed / poor inflatable-carnival fit
notes.body: Adventure Zone Gmail shows outreach to Casper Oktoberfest contacts in 2023 and 2024 with no reply found. Current official Wyoming tourism material only shows a past Casper Oktoberfest and describes the event as a downtown beer festival/bar crawl benefiting Make-A-Wish Wyoming. A current festival listing estimates Oct. 3, 2026 but explicitly says the 2026 edition is not officially confirmed and describes it as a 21+ downtown charity beer crawl. Do not create routine Adventure Zone outreach or follow-up unless an official future edition materially changes format.
